'''Bubble lifts''' were [[Hydrostatic field/Legends|hydrostatic]] bubbles which served as the counterparts of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]] in bubble cities such as [[Otoh Gunga/Legends|Otoh Gunga]].
